settings.heading: About Rano
settings.text: From Casarano's quiet streets to your next departure gate. Travel gear shaped by movement, not by seasons.

settings.heading: Not just a bag
settings.text: Born in the south of Italy, where craftsmanship is a way of life, not a trend. Every line and every stitch is shaped by tradition and finished with intention. Now that heritage moves forward to Amsterdam: historic streets, modern lives, decisive movement.

settings.heading: From Casarano to your next voyage
settings.text:
Rano was born in Casarano, a small town in southern Italy where days move slowly and details matter. We carry that spirit into every piece we design: clean lines, rich textures and quiet confidence.

We work exclusively with real leather, carefully selected for its natural feel and the way it softens and ages over time.

settings.heading: Discretion over display
settings.text:
Rather than chasing seasons, we focus on understated travel pieces that feel right year after year. The Traveller is the first expression of that idea: a weekender made to keep pace with you, wherever you go.

Limited releases. No restocks.

settings.heading: Designed in Italy. Carried in Amsterdam.
